description: This file defines the entity class 'TimesheetItem' used in the OrangeHRM system for managing time tracking. It specifies properties such as id, date, duration, comment, and associations with other entities like Timesheet, Project, ProjectActivity, and Employee. It includes ORM annotations for database mapping and uses a trait for decorators.

classes.name: TimesheetItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet item with properties for tracking work hours, comments, and associations with related entities in the HR system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date for the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date for the timesheet entry.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration (in some unit) of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comments associated with the timesheet item.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the timesheet item.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity with this item.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this item.

methods.name: setProjectActivity
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity with this item.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created or is responsible for this timesheet item.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this timesheet item.
